label: v193
changes: A finished document read stops saying it's still reading. The line above the answer was written the moment the search started and never updated, so every answer in your chat — including ones from weeks ago — claimed to be happening right that second. It now reads in the past tense once the search is done.

Changing the app's language now reaches the document reader. The reader was being handed whichever language was set when the chat first opened, so switching afterwards left answers and translations in the old one until you reloaded.
